# Open choices: package-publishing

`aidd-team:package-publishing` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api-diff-tool` | Which tool compares the public API of a release with the last published one? | The ecosystem's own API diff tool, run in CI before each publish, as the Public API diff test lists for Rust, TypeScript, and Java. | cargo-semver-checks, api-extractor, japicmp-maven-plugin, a committed API report, diffed in CI |
